chunks: Ja'far ibn Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdullah ibn al-Mughira al-Kufi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan ibn Ali narrated to me from his grandfather Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Isma'il ibn Muslim al-Sakuni, from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Whoever makes the Quran his speech and the mosque his home, Allah will build a house for him in Paradise.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةُ: Paradise — the ultimate eschatological reward for the devoted believer
key_terms.بَيْتَهُ: His home — indicating constant presence and attachment to the mosque
key_terms.حَدِيثَهُ: His speech/conversation — indicating the Quran is his habitual discourse

ai.seo_question: What reward does Allah give to someone who makes the Quran his speech and the mosque his home?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that the one who makes the Quran his constant speech — meaning he habitually recites, studies, and discusses it — and makes the mosque his home — meaning he frequents it for worship and learning — will be rewarded with a house built by God in Paradise. This hadith was transmitted through a chain including Imam al-Sadiq (AS) and his forefathers back to the Prophet, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Ahlulbayt as the authoritative transmitters of prophetic teachings. The original audience would have understood 'his speech' (hadithahu) as making Quran recitation the dominant feature of one's daily discourse, and 'his home' (baytahu) as the devoted worshipper's intimate relationship with the mosque.

en.bilal-muhammad: Ja`far b. `Ali b. al-Hasan b. `Ali b. `Abdullah b. al-Mughira al-Kufi (ra) narrated to us. He said: My grandfather al-Hasan b. `Ali narrated to me from his grandfather `Abdullah b. al-Mughira from Isma`il b. Muslim al-Sukuni from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
He whose speech is the Quran and whose home is the mosque, Allah will build a house for him in Paradise.
